naslov: AI Wars Ep. 26: Anthropic vs OpenAI: rival math proofs drop same day
opis:
Anthropic and OpenAI each posted their own proof of VP ≠ VNP on GitHub on the same day, with no advance notice. It's the algebraic version of P vs NP, open since 1979. A day later OpenAI released nine more Lean-checked papers, and Google quietly posted six papers from its Cogentic system, including a new bound for integer factoring. All results are still being checked, and nobody has confirmed rumors of a lab quickly breaking RSA.

naslov: Google Workspace MCP servers: let AI agents use Gmail and Drive | AI Tool #33
opis:
Google has made eight Workspace MCP servers generally available. These are standard connectors that let an agent work with Gmail, Drive and other services. There's also a command-line tool, gwscli. You get 5,000 free requests per day per product.

How to try it:
1. Open Phil Schmid's post and follow the link to the docs
2. Add the Workspace MCP server you want to Claude Code: claude mcp add … (check the exact server address at the link)
3. Try a task like "find emails from client X and save the attachment to Drive"

Price: free up to 5,000 requests per day per product

Official link: https://x.com/_philschmid/status/2125296446459056156

naslov: What is AI inference? Explained in 30 seconds
opis:
Inference is what happens when a trained AI model actually runs: your prompt goes in and an answer comes out, using computing power every single time. Today's example: OpenAI is testing Private Inference with its first business customers, where queries to its strongest models run on isolated hardware that even OpenAI can't see into, and outside parties can check that hardware's security.
